name: PixelCard-TS-TW
title: Pixel Reveal Card
description: Three dark rounded cards sit side by side, each with a title and a hint to hover. On hover a field of small squares swells across the card and shimmers until the pointer leaves.
use: A feature or teaser card should reward hover with a tactile pixel flourish.
avoid: The pixels are decorative only, and the whole effect needs a pointer or keyboard focus to appear.
a11y: It honours reduced-motion, but the card has no role or instructions, so the focus-triggered animation is unexplained. (keyboard: partial, labels: none, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Three near-black rounded cards in a row, each centred with a small title, a muted subtitle and a pill reading 'Hover me'. A hovered card fills with a dense grid of tiny pale squares.
behaves: Hovering a card sprouts a field of small pixels from the centre outward, which keep pulsing in size while the pointer stays. Leaving makes them shrink away and leaves the plain card.
customise: Variant (default, blue, yellow, pink), pixel gap, speed, colour list and whether the card is focusable are props; size and border come from classes.
weight: moderate: Thousands of tiny canvas squares are redrawn every frame while a card is hovered.
